llm_response.reason: WonderREX is a well-documented, longstanding Japanese 'recycle shop' (second-hand goods retailer) operated by REXT株式会社, part of the RIZAP Group. The website's ownership, business practices, privacy notes, and contact information are transparent and verified in independent search results and Wikipedia. None of the characteristic scam elements (unrealistic returns, urgency, fake endorsements, spoofing, etc.) are present. Only the SSL certificate issue was noted, but this alone without any other red-flag elements does not indicate a scam.
